entities.name: Efreet
entities.description: Retired creature type for fiery infernal spirits noted for strength and cunning.

entities.name: Djinn
entities.description: Related creature type that replaced Efreet going forward.

entities.name: Serendib Efreet
entities.description: Vicious air-elemental efreets of Rabiah with double mouths.

entities.name: Karli
entities.description: Desert wizard who summoned a Junun efreet to attack Gull's army.

entities.name: Nassari
entities.description: Efreet dean of the Prismari College.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: Dragonlord who conquered Qadat in the new timeline.

entities.name: Jan bin Jan
entities.description: Ruler of the plane of Wildfire.

events.summary: Starting with Modern Horizons 3, Efreet is retired as a creature type in favor of Djinn.
events.quote: Efreet was retired as a creature type, with Design preference Djinn going forward.

events.summary: Ages ago a Serendib Efreet aids a planeswalker in exchange for the power to destroy anything on Rabiah, and is later defeated.
events.quote: He was defeated by a Bird Maiden and a nomad

events.summary: Karli summons a Junun efreet in 4074 and 4077 AR to attack Gull's army.
events.quote: summoned a female Junún efreet in 4074 and 4077 AR to attack Gull 's army

events.summary: In the new timeline, efreets join the Atarka Clan after Sarkhan conquers Qadat.
events.quote: Efreets became part of the Atarka Clan after the dragonlord conquered Qadat.

relations.note: Ruled by Emberwilde Caliph Jan bin Jan.
relations.quote: currently being ruled by Emberwilde Caliph Jan bin Jan
